property.name: dialogue
property.value: ["Oh, so it is you. The one Master Elysia approached for assistance.","The name is Orin Breakpoint. I am a professor here in J.S. Academy. A pleasure to meet the Master's aquaintance.","If you need of any assistance, please feel free to ask."]

property.name: dialogue
property.value: ["Ah, you're here. My name is Elysia Codewright, the Master of this city.","Since you came here early as I expected, let me debrief you on the matter.","The city here is in trouble, as bugs from the outskirts disabled our monoliths.","Those monoliths are our city's power source, and without it, our city will cease to exist.","I gathered enough info from Kaelen and Orin, and your main goal is to get keycards to activate those monoliths.","How to obtain keycards, you ask?","You have to learn our city's main structure and power, JavaScript.","That way, Kaelen, your teacher for now, will assist you on learning each important parts to progress yourself.","Because the bugs on the outskirts are really dangerous, please be careful.","That is all for now. You can start by learning the JavaScript Syntax.", "Look for the house that has a banner with a semi-colon (;) designed on it. Good luck."]

property.name: dialogue
property.value: ["Ah, aren't you the Master's aquaintance? Finally, someone that I haven't met before!","The name is Kaelen Scriptforge at your service.","What's my role? Well, I am the head guildmaster of this building named Scriptforge Guild! Pretty cool, right?","My guild offers a lot of items you can use when traveling to the outskirts! Not good if your health is low, oh no!","That's why I stocked up on supplies to help my guild members and you!","Oh right. My items are not free, you see. We use Cryptos as our currency. Digital money, I tell you, super convenient!","Hmm... since you are the Master's aquaintance, I'll give you some Cryptos! Sound's good, buddy?","That's more like it! If you want, go buy our items now! Just press Z over the door.","Hehe... Well, the inside is really messy because of the attack just happened recently. So, right now, just go to that door and I'll give you the items you need."]
